title: WaterColor 37 Royal Fern Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 10 amenity access bands.**- Located in the beautiful Forest community of WaterColor- Uniquely Located near multiple community pools- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- Private pool and sitting spa *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $60 per day.- 6 Passenger LSV- 4 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout-parking for 2 vehicles*This is a non-smoking home. Smoking is not allowed inside or anywhere on the property.Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Indulge in a fun WaterColor getaway at 37 Royal Fern Way, a 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home, sleeping 10 guests and boasting a private pool and sitting spa. Enjoy access to WaterColor’s illustrious amenities, including shared pools, nature trails, beach access, and a beach club. Guests will love spending sun-dappled days splashing in the pool and drinking ice-cold lemonade on the deck!A lovely front porch with a deep porch swing, Adirondack seating, and overhead fans welcomes guests upon arrival. Step inside the 2-level home to find rich hardwood floors and white wainscotting elegantly adorning the first-level great room. A soft, slip-covered sectional and 2 armchairs make up the living area—perfect for conversing with the group or hosting movie nights on the wall-mounted TV. The space flows effortlessly into the vast kitchen, featuring high-end appliances and a 4-stool breakfast bar for casual meals or quick bites. Adjacent is the dining room with an 8-person formal table for group dinners. Head outside, where a spacious deck with an alfresco table and overhead fan offers a prime spot to enjoy meals in the coastal breeze. A few steps down is the glistening private pool and spa, surrounded by loungers, chairs, and thriving greenery for ultimate privacy. At the end of the day, retire to the bright guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. Feel free to pack light thanks to the washer and dryer.On the second floor, find the beautiful primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom, as well as a guest bedroom with a king bed. The kid-friendly bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds and 2 twin beds completes the level.An unforgettable Scenic 30A vacation awaits at 37 Royal Fern Way in WaterColor. On-site parking makes it easy to explore or hop on the complimentary 4 adult bikes for a leisurely cruise around the neighborhood. For private beach access, guests can visit the beach club in WaterColor. The nearest public beach access is a short 11-minute walk at the end of South County Highway 395. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds and 2 Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Per HOA Policy, all Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Homes are permitted one Low-Speed Vehicle per home. Homes with owner provided Low-Speed Vehicles are not permitted to rent an additional Low-Speed Vehicle.
